name: currency_convert
description: Live currency conversion for financial workflows. Converts amounts between any fiat currency pair using real-time interbank rates. Required inputs: amount, source currency (ISO 4217), target currency (ISO 4217). Returns converted amount, applied rate, and timestamp. Suitable for invoicing, payments, and treasury operations.

amount.description: Amount to convert. Must be positive.

from.description: Source currency code. ISO 4217. e.g. USD, GBP, EUR.

to.description: Target currency code. ISO 4217. e.g. EUR, CHF, JPY.
